name: Allowlisted fetch read-only MCP
summary: Fetch bounded HTTPS documentation from three explicit hosts through a pinned MCP server.
description: Installs a local stdio MCP server that fetches bounded documents only from the declared MDN, GitHub Docs, and Node.js documentation hosts, without credentials and without following redirects.
refuses: It does not fetch from hosts outside the exact declared HTTPS documentation allowlist.
It does not send credentials, follow redirects, submit request bodies, or accept arbitrary headers.
It does not claim fetched content is trusted, current, non-malicious, or suitable for execution.

entrypoints.purpose: Serve one bounded credential-free HTTPS retrieval tool over local standard input and output.

mcpServer.trustBoundary: Only bounded response bodies from the three declared HTTPS documentation hosts cross the server boundary; credentials, redirects, request bodies, and other hosts are excluded.
